```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../../_shared/template/polaris_rmd_helpers.R")
Sys.setenv(VELKSCALA_ROOT = "E:/Active Projects/Project 1746 - Intellte/papers/velkscala")

sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\u2013", "-", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("---", " - ", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("--", "-", text, fixed = TRUE)

  cmd_vault <- character(0)
  stash_cmd <- function(m) {
    idx <- length(cmd_vault) + 1L
    cmd_vault[[idx]] <<- m
    paste0("@@LTXCMD", idx, "@@")
  }
  m_cmd <- gregexpr("\\\\[a-zA-Z]+(\\{[^{}]*\\})*", text, perl = TRUE)
  if (m_cmd[[1]][1] != -1) {
    matched <- regmatches(text, m_cmd)[[1]]
    repl <- vapply(matched, stash_cmd, character(1))
    regmatches(text, m_cmd) <- list(repl)
  }

  text <- gsub("\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*", "\\\\textbf{\\1}", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\\*([^*]+)\\*", "\\\\textit{\\1}", text, perl = TRUE)

  m_cmd2 <- gregexpr("\\\\(textbf|textit)\\{[^{}]*\\}", text, perl = TRUE)
  if (m_cmd2[[1]][1] != -1) {
    matched2 <- regmatches(text, m_cmd2)[[1]]
    repl2 <- vapply(matched2, stash_cmd, character(1))
    regmatches(text, m_cmd2) <- list(repl2)
  }

  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)#", "\\\\#", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)\\^", "\\\\textasciicircum{}", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", text, perl = TRUE)

  unicode_map <- list(
    c("\u00b1", "\\ensuremath{\\pm}"),
    c("\u00d7", "\\ensuremath{\\times}"),
    c("\u00b0", "\\ensuremath{^{\\circ}}"),
    c("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}"),
    c("\u00b3", "\\textsuperscript{3}"),
    c("\u2248", "\\ensuremath{\\approx}"),
    c("\u2264", "\\ensuremath{\\le}"),
    c("\u2265", "\\ensuremath{\\ge}"),
    c("\u2260", "\\ensuremath{\\neq}"),
    c("\u2192", "\\ensuremath{\\rightarrow}"),
    c("\u2190", "\\ensuremath{\\leftarrow}"),
    c("\u2194", "\\ensuremath{\\leftrightarrow}"),
    c("\u03b1", "\\ensuremath{\\alpha}"),
    c("\u03b2", "\\ensuremath{\\beta}"),
    c("\u03b3", "\\ensuremath{\\gamma}"),
    c("\u03b4", "\\ensuremath{\\delta}"),
    c("\u03b5", "\\ensuremath{\\varepsilon}"),
    c("\u03b8", "\\ensuremath{\\theta}"),
    c("\u03bb", "\\ensuremath{\\lambda}"),
    c("\u03bc", "\\ensuremath{\\mu}"),
    c("\u03c0", "\\ensuremath{\\pi}"),
    c("\u03c1", "\\ensuremath{\\rho}"),
    c("\u03c3", "\\ensuremath{\\sigma}"),
    c("\u03c4", "\\ensuremath{\\tau}"),
    c("\u03c6", "\\ensuremath{\\varphi}"),
    c("\u03c7", "\\ensuremath{\\chi}"),
    c("\u03c9", "\\ensuremath{\\omega}"),
    c("\u0394", "\\ensuremath{\\Delta}"),
    c("\u03a3", "\\ensuremath{\\Sigma}"),
    c("\u03a9", "\\ensuremath{\\Omega}")
  )
  for (pair in unicode_map) {
    text <- gsub(pair[1], pair[2], text, fixed = TRUE)
  }

  if (length(cmd_vault) > 0) {
    for (idx in rev(seq_along(cmd_vault))) {
      text <- gsub(paste0("@@LTXCMD", idx, "@@"), cmd_vault[[idx]], text, fixed = TRUE)
    }
  }

  return(text)
}

local({
   sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function(lines) {
    in_chunk <- FALSE
    in_yaml <- FALSE
    yaml_delim_count <- 0L
    unicode_prose_map <- list(
      c("\u2014", " - "),
      c("\u2013", "-"),
      c("\u00b1", "$\\\\pm$"),
      c("\u00d7", "$\\\\times$"),
      c("\u2248", "$\\\\approx$"),
      c("\u2264", "$\\\\le$"),
      c("\u2265", "$\\\\ge$"),
      c("\u2260", "$\\\\neq$"),
      c("\u2192", "$\\\\rightarrow$"),
      c("\u2190", "$\\\\leftarrow$"),
      c("\u2194", "$\\\\leftrightarrow$"),
      c("\u03b1", "$\\\\alpha$"),
      c("\u03b2", "$\\\\beta$"),
      c("\u03b3", "$\\\\gamma$"),
      c("\u03b4", "$\\\\delta$"),
      c("\u03b5", "$\\\\varepsilon$"),
      c("\u03b8", "$\\\\theta$"),
      c("\u03bb", "$\\\\lambda$"),
      c("\u03bc", "$\\\\mu$"),
      c("\u03c0", "$\\\\pi$"),
      c("\u03c1", "$\\\\rho$"),
      c("\u03c3", "$\\\\sigma$"),
      c("\u03c4", "$\\\\tau$"),
      c("\u03c6", "$\\\\varphi$"),
      c("\u03c7", "$\\\\chi$"),
      c("\u03c9", "$\\\\omega$"),
      c("\u0394", "$\\\\Delta$"),
      c("\u03a3", "$\\\\Sigma$"),
      c("\u03a9", "$\\\\Omega$")
    )
    for (i in seq_along(lines)) {
      line <- lines[i]
      if (grepl("^---\\s*$", line)) {
        yaml_delim_count <- yaml_delim_count + 1L
        in_yaml <- (yaml_delim_count == 1L)
        next
      }
      if (in_yaml) {
        line <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", line, fixed = TRUE)
        line <- gsub("\u2013", "-", line, fixed = TRUE)
        lines[i] <- line
        next
      }
      if (grepl("^```", line)) {
        in_chunk <- !in_chunk
        next
      }
      if (!in_chunk) {
        for (pair in unicode_prose_map) {
          line <- gsub(pair[1], pair[2], line, fixed = TRUE)
        }
        lines[i] <- line
      }
    }
    lines
  }

  rmd_input <- knitr::current_input()
  if (!is.null(rmd_input) && nzchar(rmd_input) && file.exists(rmd_input)) {
    raw_lines <- readLines(rmd_input, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
    clean_lines <- sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex(raw_lines)
    if (!identical(raw_lines, clean_lines)) {
      writeLines(clean_lines, rmd_input, useBytes = TRUE)
    }
  }
})
```

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE <- "wild_fields_settlements.json"
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}
last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  return(paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; "))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])
  lon <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])
  fmt_deg <- function(val) {
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(val)))
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    s
  }
  lat_s <- paste0(fmt_deg(lat), if (lat >= 0) "°N" else "°S")
  lon_s <- paste0(fmt_deg(lon), if (lon >= 0) "°E" else "°W")
  return(paste0(lat_s, ", ", lon_s))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

get_pop_window_val <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin, arg2_ymax) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  idx <- keep[which.max(yrs[keep])]
  return(fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
}
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles coordinates, historical names and benchmark population estimates for 191 settlements and archaeological sites across the Wild Fields and Budjak (~238k km²) between the Lower Danube and the Seversky Donets from 10000BC to 1400AD. Prehistoric entries cover Ice Age and Mesolithic river camps (Anetovka II, Mirnoe and the Vasylivka rapids cemeteries), Copper Age Bolgrad-Aldeni and Usatovo villages, the Yamnaya stone fort at Mikhailovka and Late Bronze Age Sabatinovka farming villages and Bakhmut copper mines (Kartamysh). Classical and Late Antique entries track the Milesian Greek ports of Pontic Olbia (12k - 15k in 500BC), Tyras (6k), Nikonion and Berezan, the 1,2k ha Scythian ironworking town of Kamenskoye Gorodishche (6k), the 16 Late Scythian stone forts on the Lower Dnieper and the dense village network of the Chernyakhov culture up to 375AD. Medieval entries follow the *Dridu* villages of Budjak, the Khazar-era Saltovo-Mayaki forts on the Seversky Donets (led by Sidorovo at 5k in 900AD), the Kievan Rus river ports of Oleshye (3,5k in 1200AD), Protolche and Igren-Samar, the Polovtsian winter towns of Sharukhan, Sugrov and Balin, and the fourteenth-century Golden Horde, Genoese, Moldavian and Lithuanian ports of Aq Qerman (15k - 16k in 1300AD), Kiliia (6,5k - 8k), Velyki Kuchugury (5,5k - 6k), Dashov and Khadzhibey.

# Methodology

The `r length(settlements_list)` settlements and archaeological sites of the Wild Fields and Budjak (~238k km²) recorded between 10000BC and 1400AD are listed below across its five regions: Budjak (I), the north-western Pontic steppe (II), the right-bank Bug-Dnieper and Ingul-Ingulets uplands (III), the left-bank Lower Dnieper, Veliky Lug and northern Taurida steppe (IV) and the Middle Seversky Donets and Azov basin (V).

Each entry gives the settlement name, historical or alternative names, coordinates, dates of occupation and population estimates. Figures are based on site area and house counts for prehistoric camps and Bronze Age villages, Greek town and rural hinterland surveys, *Dridu* and *Saltovo-Mayaki* fort enclosures, Kievan Rus chronicle and excavation evidence and Golden Horde, Genoese, Moldavian and Lithuanian port records up to 1400AD [@kryzhitsky1999; @subbotin2000; @kravchenko2020; @dovzhenok1961; @bocharov2015; @boguslavskiy2014].

```{r tab-epoch-summary, results='asis'}
cnt_prehist <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) <= -1000, logical(1)))
cnt_classic <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > -1000 && first_year_num(s) <= 400, logical(1)))
cnt_med     <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > 400 && first_year_num(s) <= 1200, logical(1)))
cnt_horde   <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > 1200 && first_year_num(s) <= 1400, logical(1)))

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Horizon = c(
    "I. Prehistoric, Copper Age & Bronze Age (10000BC - 1000BC)",
    "II. Classical Greek Ports, Scythia, Late Scythian & Chernyakhov (700BC - 400AD)",
    "III. Early Medieval, Dridu (Budjak), Saltovo-Mayaki, Kievan Rus & Cuman (500AD - 1200AD)",
    "IV. Golden Horde, Genoese, Moldavian-Budjak & Lithuanian Ports (1240AD - 1400AD)",
    "Total Gazetteer Settlements"
  ),
  First_Attested_Count = as.character(c(
    cnt_prehist, cnt_classic, cnt_med, cnt_horde, length(settlements_list)
  )),
  Representative_Sites = c(
    "Anetovka II, Mirnoe [Budjak], Vovnigi, Mariupol, Dereivka, Bolhrad-Yalpug [Budjak], Usatovo, Mikhailovka, Sabatinovka, Kartamysh",
    "Tyras [Budjak], Orlovka/Aliobrix [Budjak], Olbia, Berezan, Nikonion, Kamenskoye, Chertomlyk, Zolota Balka, Krasny Mayak, Bashmachka",
    "Voznesenka, Suvorovo-Katlabukh [Budjak], Sidorovo, Mayaki-Tsaritsyno, Sukhaya Gomolsha, Oleshye, Protolche, Igren-Samar, Sharukhan",
    "Aq Qerman / Maurocastro [Budjak], Kiliia / Lycostomo [Budjak], Smil / Izmail [Budjak], Kuchugury, Konski Vody, Khadzhibey, Dashov",
    "All five regions of the Wild Fields and Budjak"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  summary_df,
  list(
    caption = "Breakdown of the 191 settlements and sites in the Wild Fields and Budjak by period of first record, showing the main prehistoric camps, Classical ports, early medieval forts and Golden Horde trading towns.",
    col_names = c("Period", "Sites", "Main Settlements & Sites"),
    label = "tab:epoch-summary"
  )
)
```

# Results

## Prehistoric, Copper Age and Bronze Age Sites

Table \ref{tab:prehistoric-sites} lists the `r cnt_prehist` prehistoric sites first attested between 10000BC and 1000BC, including Ice Age and Mesolithic hunting camps, the Dnieper Rapids cemeteries, Bolgrad-Aldeni (Gumelnita) and Usatovo Copper Age villages, Yamnaya forts and Sabatinovka-Srubnaya farming and copper-mining settlements [@olenkovskiy2010; @telegin1986; @subbotin2000; @chernienko2014].

```{r tab-prehistoric-sites, results='asis'}
pre_list <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) <= -1000, settlements_list)
pre_df <- data.frame(
  Name = vapply(pre_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  Aliases = vapply(pre_list, fmt_other_names, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(pre_list, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Span = vapply(pre_list, fmt_span, character(1)),
  Pop_Series = vapply(pre_list, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, -10000, 1400), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  pre_df,
  list(
    caption = "Prehistoric, Copper Age and Bronze Age sites across the Wild Fields and Budjak founded between 10000BC and 1000BC, giving coordinates, alternative names, dates of occupation and population estimates.",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Alternative Names", "Coords", "Attested Span", "Population Estimates (<= 1400AD)"),
    label = "tab:prehistoric-sites"
  )
)
```

## Classical, Scythian and Chernyakhov Settlements

Table \ref{tab:classical-sites} lists the `r cnt_classic` settlements first attested during the Classical Greek, Scythian, Sarmatian, Late Scythian and Chernyakhov periods (700BC - 400AD) across Budjak, the Dniester-Bug Liman and the Dnieper-Donets steppes [@kryzhitsky1989; @grakov1954; @bylkova2010; @gudkova1999].

```{r tab-classical-sites, results='asis'}
cls_list <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) > -1000 && first_year_num(s) <= 400, settlements_list)
cls_df <- data.frame(
  Name = vapply(cls_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  Aliases = vapply(cls_list, fmt_other_names, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(cls_list, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Span = vapply(cls_list, fmt_span, character(1)),
  Pop_Series = vapply(cls_list, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, -700, 1400), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  cls_df,
  list(
    caption = "Greek coastal towns (Olbia, Tyras, Nikonion and Berezan), Royal Scythian centres, Late Scythian Lower Dnieper stone forts and Chernyakhov villages first occupied between 700BC and 400AD.",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Alternative Names", "Coords", "Attested Span", "Population Estimates (<= 1400AD)"),
    label = "tab:classical-sites"
  )
)
```

## Medieval Settlements and Ports

Table \ref{tab:medieval-cossack-sites} lists the `r cnt_med + cnt_horde` settlements first attested between 500AD and 1400AD, covering Antae/Penkovka rapids villages, the Voznesenka camp, the *Dridu* villages of Budjak, the *Saltovo-Mayaki* forts on the Seversky Donets, the Kievan Rus ports of Oleshye and Protolche, the Polovtsian winter towns and the Golden Horde, Genoese, Moldavian and Lithuanian ports of Aq Qerman (Maurocastro), Kiliia (Lycostomo), Smil (Izmail), Kuchugury, Mamai-Surka, Khadzhibey and Dashov [@kravchenko2020; @dovzhenok1961; @bocharov2015; @boguslavskiy2014].

```{r tab-medieval-cossack-sites, results='asis'}
med_list <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) > 400 && first_year_num(s) <= 1400, settlements_list)
med_df <- data.frame(
  Name = vapply(med_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  Aliases = vapply(med_list, fmt_other_names, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(med_list, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Span = vapply(med_list, fmt_span, character(1)),
  Pop_Series = vapply(med_list, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, 500, 1400), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  med_df,
  list(
    caption = "Early and late medieval settlements founded between 500AD and 1400AD, tracking Danubian Bulgarian villages in Budjak, Khazar-era Saltovo forts on the Donets, Kievan Rus river ports and fourteenth-century Golden Horde and Italian trading towns.",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Alternative Names", "Coords", "Attested Span", "Population Estimates (500AD - 1400AD)"),
    label = "tab:medieval-cossack-sites"
  )
)
```

# Appendix

## Complete Settlement Directory

Table \ref{tab:master-gazetteer} provides the complete alphabetical list of all `r length(settlements_list)` settlements in the gazetteer, giving each settlement's name, alternative historical names, coordinates, attested span and benchmark population estimates from 10000BC to 1400AD.

```{r tab-master-gazetteer, results='asis'}
alpha_idx <- order(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)))
alpha_list <- settlements_list[alpha_idx]

master_df <- data.frame(
  Name = vapply(alpha_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  Aliases = vapply(alpha_list, fmt_other_names, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(alpha_list, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Span = vapply(alpha_list, fmt_span, character(1)),
  Full_Trajectory = vapply(alpha_list, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, -10000, 1400), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  master_df,
  list(
    caption = "Master alphabetical directory of all 191 settlements and sites in the Wild Fields and Budjak, pairing decimal coordinates and occupied date spans with the full sequence of population estimates up to 1400AD.",
    col_names = c("Settlement Name", "Alternative / Historical Names", "Coords", "Span", "Benchmark Population Series"),
    label = "tab:master-gazetteer"
  )
)
```
